run_googletest_catch_exceptions_test: run the googletest catch exceptions test to verify C++ and SEH exception catching behavior
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_fixture_cons: test that C++ exceptions thrown in a test fixture constructor are caught and logged
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_SetUpTestSui: test that C++ exceptions thrown in SetUpTestSuite are caught and remaining lifecycle methods still run
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_test_body: test that C++ exceptions thrown in the test body are caught and TearDown still executes
test_CatchCxxExceptionsTest_unhandled_ab: test that unhandled C++ exceptions abort the program when catch_exceptions is disabled
